claim: A survey of a long recording is very slow (64 minutes for a 63-minute recording); the tool now warns and reuses a stored result.

evidence.text: A 64-minute survey of a 63-minute recording (189,333 frames); the survey tool now warns and reuses a result; the findings came from survey counts and disassembly.
evidence.quote: a 64-minute survey of a 63-minute recording; it now warns and reuses a result.
